user.title: Hunter BTT Tap Timer
user.description: Close the Hunter app first: the timer accepts one connection at a time. Pick the timer, or type its Bluetooth address if it isn't listed. Choose two outlets only if your timer has two hose outputs. Older timers always get one.

error.bad_address: That doesn't look like a Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

abort.already_configured: This timer is already set up.

init.title: Hunter BTT Tap Timer
init.description: Change the number of outlets. The timer reloads when you save.
